prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
engine_stated_criteria: best AI video ad maker depends on your use case
answer_verbatim:
The **best AI video ad maker depends on your use case**, but the strongest “overall” picks in the results are **Creatify** for broad AI video ad generation[1] and **HeyGen** for avatar-driven ads and multilingual ad creation[2][19]. If you want the most practical answer for most marketers, **HeyGen** is the best fit when you need realistic talking-head or testimonial-style ads across many languages[2][19].

A useful way to choose is:

| Need | Best pick | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Overall broad video ad generation | **Creatify** | Ranked “best of the best” for creating lots of high-quality video ads[1] |
| Avatar/testimonial ads | **HeyGen** | Strong avatar quality, multilingual reach, and automated ad creation[2][19] |
| DTC / performance marketing volume | **ClipLoft** | Highlighted for speed, batch generation, and product compositing[6][8] |
| Ecommerce / product-image-to-video | **Creatify** or **DeeVid AI** | Strong for product-focused ad workflows[1][15] |
| Social-first SMBs | **Predis.ai** | Recommended as an all-around social-first option[15] |

If you want a single recommendation without more context, **HeyGen** is the safest pick for most ad creators because it combines realistic ad avatars with multilingual output and was ranked best overall for ads in one of the more detailed testing-based guides[2][19]. If your priority is sheer ad volume and ecommerce-style creative generation, **Creatify** is the strongest alternative[1].
